scripts/test-preview-loading-presentatio.reason: Production Preview loading feedback: silent fast/warm activation, delayed full/side loading, editable Source, silent refresh, cancellation and failure. Captures actual loading surfaces.

scripts/test-source-preview-edit-ownersh.reason: Production Source split Preview: native caret auto-scroll during input, stale render coordinates, gesture ownership, idle publication and delayed explicit source clicks.

scripts/test-preview-table-source-identi.reason: Actual Source split Preview preserves unchanged ordinary table DOM, column tracks, reading position and compositor pixels when new preceding paragraphs shift source lines and logical block indices; covers full and windowed Preview.

scripts/test-preview-table-bands.ts.reason: Source-backed giant Markdown table bands bound rendering and inline parsing; exact rich-row/export parity, complete logical copy/search, source navigation and conservative container boundaries.

scripts/test-preview-table-bands-product.reason: Actual production Worker/bootstrap and Preview iframe: bounded giant-table DOM, whole-table column consistency, native wheel, first/last boundaries and compositor stability during distant Source input.

scripts/test-table-worker-history.ts.reason: Full production bootstrap with actual Markdown Worker; content-only Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y must retain the original giant-table native input during pending parse/context publication after a Preview round trip.

scripts/test-large-table-row-window.ts.reason: Real 1600-row Live table bounds mounted rows/editors; variable heights, gutters, logical navigation, every input frame, history/modes, widths/fonts, accessibility changes, source mapping and complete offscreen rich/Markdown clipboard with images, HTML, formulas and footnotes.

scripts/test-large-table-gutter-budget.t.reason: Production 1600-row table bounds gutter geometry work to its reading band, preserves complete aligned visible line numbers and DOM identity, and checks resize, line-number remount and source-line changes.

scripts/test-deferred-markdown-inline.ts.reason: Real Preview inline-parse work count for offscreen tables with void breaks; complete eager/lazy HTML, heading and cross-root container partition parity.

scripts/test-initial-document-sharing.ts.reason: Actual Webview bootstrap and snapshot producer must share the initial persistent Text with Editor and saved text; first large-document edit, undo and hidden Preview startup budget remain correct.

scripts/test-footnote-code-line-reuse.ts.reason: Proven inline-only footnote substitutions reuse the code-line index; block-start references and link definitions retain fresh structural parsing. Compares 504 container/HTML/code cases to fresh masks and counts whole-document scans in real Preview preparation.

scripts/test-preview-image-layout.ts.reason: Actual Preview iframe reserves known natural image geometry before delayed decoding, preserves authored HTML dimensions and keeps following text stable.

scripts/test-image-dimensions.ts.reason: Bounded asynchronous local image header catalog, aliases, invalid files, disposal and dimension metadata protocol validation. First-arrival DOM geometry uses test-image-layout.

scripts/test-mermaid-elk-layout.ts.reason: ELK worker layout projection preserves Mermaid renderer aliases; checks bounded serialization, queue admission, errors/retry, stale replies, timeout, idle retirement and late disposal. Actual CSP and geometry use test-mermaid-module-runtime.

scripts/test-mermaid-module-runtime.ts.reason: Actual CSP module loading, lazy Source prefetch, shared runtime, bounded core payload, classic/module geometry including ELK/math and failure retry; run after build:webview.

scripts/test-markdown-mixed-languages.ts.reason: Exact comparison with official CodeMirror Markdown mixed parsing for source coordinates, nested language paths and the complete palette across code aliases, containers and HTML overlays.

scripts/test-background-markdown-structu.reason: Actual CSP-constrained Markdown worker through Source/Live, staged global context, numbering changes, CJK input and undo, with zero foreground full parsing or global footnote/rich-block discovery.

scripts/test-markdown-tree-transfer.ts.reason: Exact incremental syntax graph transfer, structural sharing and reference-counted retirement across edits, old-root reuse and failure.

scripts/test-mixed-code-viewport-demand..reason: Real editor prepares complete outer Markdown without distant code parsing, keeps source intact across modes and recovers the same code palette when scrolling to skipped grammar.

scripts/test-markdown-structure.ts.reason: Checks explicit complete outer-Markdown proof, incomplete-tree rejection, deferred embedded languages and viewport demand without weakening ordinary parsing.

scripts/test-live-gutter-read-budget.ts.reason: Production Live caret movement with a ready Git baseline must not enumerate every source line in an unchanged large document.

scripts/test-viewport-syntax-highlightin.reason: Exact mixed-language and ancestor-style parity; actual Editor limits palette DOM to the physical viewport while retaining overscan, handles intra-buffer scrolling, deferred input, resize, modes and disposal.

scripts/test-table-source-geometry.ts.reason: Differential source-bound checks across nested tables and footnotes, with a work-count assertion that global geometry cannot construct detailed cell models.

scripts/test-source-code-window.ts.reason: Production Source input into a 9,000-row code document must avoid offscreen row enumeration while distant mounted code rows retain their styling.

scripts/test-structural-syntax-snapshot..reason: Locks down parser advancement at the actual mixed code/table/footnote descriptor boundary; run for changes to shared structural readers.

scripts/test-shiki-worker.ts.reason: Real classic Worker differential and cancellation checks for editor coloring, plus a bounded foreground responsiveness probe; run after build:webview when changing the highlighting execution boundary.

scripts/test-block-copy-consistency.ts.reason: Supplementary block-copy diagnosis using a stub diagram renderer; retained outside the existing release gate. Use for clipboard changes, not as a substitute for production clipboard contracts.

scripts/test-block-sticky-header-product.reason: Supplementary Mermaid editing pack; test:mermaid-editing invokes this broader interaction probe. The release gate already runs the distinct viewport persistence contracts.

scripts/test-github-readme-compatibility.reason: Compatibility audit fixture with explicitly pending probes; belongs to test:preview-presets. Its audit result is additional evidence, not the complete release preset acceptance.

scripts/test-history-rendered-block-chro.reason: Supplementary controlled DOM history reproduction in test:history-rendered-block-interaction; release retains its production mixed-history matrix.

scripts/test-kbd-appearance.ts.reason: Supplementary keyboard-markup appearance reproduction. Run when changing kbd rendering or export styles; not part of the existing release baseline.

scripts/test-mermaid-visible-controls.ts.reason: Supplementary visible-control diagnosis documented in mermaid-rendering.md; release separately covers Mermaid editing and viewport interactions.

scripts/test-font-size-full-document.ts.reason: Full font sweep needs a chosen document and long-run authorization. The release font-viewport test invokes only a bounded focused subset; that does not claim a full sweep.

scripts/test-production-live-scroll-inte.reason: Document-specific scroll pass in guarded UAT/endurance workflows; requires a selected acceptance document.

scripts/test-uat-full-document-endurance.reason: Full-document edit/history stress is separately authorized through test:endurance; it is not implicitly launched by inventory discovery.

scripts/test-vscode-auto-save-endurance..reason: Native extension-host save lifecycle verification requires an installed candidate and controlled VS Code session.
